polyglot.npm: transitive npm tree from the immutable base image
polyglot.go: distribution package from the pinned Debian image
polyglot.java: openjdk-21-jdk-headless from the pinned Debian image
polyglot.rust: rustc/cargo distribution packages from the pinned Debian image

notes: The image digest and Pi package are immutable inputs.
Direct Debian package versions are pinned; transitive packages remain tied to the immutable base and repository state until an apt snapshot is pinned.
package-lock.json pins and integrity-checks the complete Pi npm dependency graph.
The Python requirements lock is resolved for Python 3.13.
SBOM generation, signing, and registry publication are release evidence, not lockfile claims.
